name: Screen Slate
focus: Film/video screenings across NYC — repertory, experimental, microcinema. Essential for moving image.
notes: Website listings are JS-rendered (403/empty via fetch). THE channel is their daily email — full day listings below the essay; parse via /scout inbox. Daily listings. Venue name appears with each screening. Also check /articles for series announcements.

name: Thought Gallery
focus: Intellectual events — talks, lectures, panels, book launches across NYC institutions.
notes: 2026-07: site 403s via WebFetch. Subscribe to their weekly newsletter (thoughtgallery.org footer) — inbox is the channel. Categorized listings with venue names. Good for university and institute talks.

name: cal.red (Red Calendar)
focus: Community calendar — DIY, art, music, left-leaning cultural events.
notes: Respectful scraping only. Community-maintained; venue names informal, may need matching help.

name: NYC Noise
focus: Experimental music, noise, improv shows — often at DIY/nomadic spaces.
notes: Dense weekly listings. Venue names informal (bar names, lofts).

name: Pools.Events (formerly WithFriends)
focus: DIY/artist-run org directory + events — SFPC, Blank Forms, Spectacle, Mayday Space all host here.
notes: Browse per-org event pages; also a discovery source for new spaces.

name: NYC Parks Free Concerts
focus: All free concerts in city parks — 139 events Jul-Oct 2026. Strong world/Latin/African programming.
notes: Server-rendered listing pages; paginated. Venue = park name (create-pending OK for parks).
